scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved for the full two-nonzero-position layer, including all prefix-suffix lengths and self-overlaps. Computations corroborate finite cases but do not imply the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: No classification of all optimal codebooks, no assertion for n=2 or weights other than two, and possible unindexed earlier equivalent results. No independent external verification.
title: Sharp non-overlapping codes with exactly two nonzero symbols
